annotations.title: Get how a Pokémon is built

description: Show how one Pokémon is typically built in a regulation: its usage and rank, and the most common abilities, items, moves and stat spreads as a share of its recorded sets. Spreads use the stat-point scale the ladder records (0–32 per stat in Pokémon Champions).

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

pokemon.description: Pokémon name in English. Mega Evolutions are tracked separately, e.g. "Charizard-Mega-Y"
